text: Its constraint is not a lack of founders or public ambition; it is the conversion of that infrastructure into consistent private seed and Series A financing, international investor access, hard-currency flexibility, and repeatable exits. Yassir and VOLZ show what is possible, but they remain exceptions in a market where annual equity activity is still relatively thin. One 2026 ecosystem analysis estimated just $8 million across four equity deals in 2025, excluding the kind of exceptional capital raised by Yassir.
